description: Particle-free, 2D steady creeping flow in the upper symmetry half of the planar 4:1 contraction (paper section 2.5).

cross.description: PEO shear-viscosity control, exact Cross law expressed as Carreau-Yasuda
cross.density_source: Same carrier density as the PEO viscoelastic case
cross.parameter_provenance: a=0.718 and n=1-a make the Carreau-Yasuda exponent (n-1)/a exactly -1, reproducing the paper's Cross viscosity. Optional control, not an additional experimental medium.

peo.description: 1 wt% aqueous PEO, selected two-mode exponential simplified PTT
peo.density_source: main.pdf section 2.4 uses water density for PEO; the stated water density is 998 kg/m3
peo.parameter_provenance: User-selected rheology fit; eta_s is an effective background viscosity, not independently measured water viscosity. CaBER time is assigned to the longest model relaxation time. Normal and extensional stresses remain model predictions.

analysis_defaults.flux_definition: Integral of positive wallward velocity along the fixed-offset line [m^2/s], divided by experimental Q/(2h).
analysis_defaults.wall_stress_definition: Wall traction in Pa from solvent and both polymer modes on the same wall coordinate; pressure cancels in the tangential projection.
analysis_defaults.sharp_corner_caution: Compare at the same physical coordinates and with a fixed physical corner exclusion when reporting mesh sensitivity.
